review: All nine complete files read: authored React UI, stream requests/publisher, volatile account-scoped navigation choices and synthetic tests. No third-party copied assets included.

Sharing requires an explicit source/audience action. Automatic publication baselines prior output, excludes user prompts/import markers, binds requests to publishing revision and installation, and checks account revision around awaits. Server authorization remains a separate boundary.
Receiving requires an explicit destination and follow action. Codex binding identity/epoch and native installation are rechecked at follow; API run selection does not start or fund a model.

Source revoke remains local even when remote retirement fails; guidance distinguishes local stop from unconfirmed remote removal. Account switch drops local publishing; remote lease expiry remains server-owned.

Friends recovery starts PKCE only after a click, filters room-purpose callbacks, aborts outstanding requests on stop/unmount and presents actionable timeout/scope/account guidance without displaying the synthetic authorization URL.
Fixtures use alice/bob, example.auth0.com, dummy UUIDs and named fake bindings/runs; fetch/native operations are mocked. No real profile, conversation content, invite or credential included.
limits: Private source proposal only; no commit, push, package or deployment.
Parent Friends panel, account/binding helpers and shared contracts remain separate review inputs; this addition is not a standalone application.
Synthetic component checks do not prove two-profile delivery, room membership cutoff, funded Agent API receive, signed installation, native background timing or real OAuth consent.
Navigation preferences persist within the current renderer/account revision, not across full application restart.
